landmarks.name: Pavillon de l'éducation physique et des sports
facts: It is the main athletics complex, with pools, gyms and an indoor stadium.

facts: It is the home field of the Rouge et Or football team.

landmarks.name: Pavillon Jean-Charles-Bonenfant
facts: It houses the university's main library.

landmarks.name: Pavillon Alphonse-Desjardins
facts: It is the student centre, named after the founder of Quebec's credit union movement.

landmarks.name: Pavillon Maurice-Pollack
facts: It houses student services, set up with help from a businessman's foundation.

landmarks.name: Pavillon H.-Biermans-L.-Moraud
facts: It is a residence hall named after two donors, one of them a Belgian businessman.
